name: Breaking/coverage event (no primary anchor yet)

admission_threshold.note: Admit when N independent outlets report the same event. The page's job is showing the differences, not declaring truth.

primary_source_upgrade.description: When the official primary document lands (ruling, report, filing, data release), upgrade the event to anchored type and rebuild

outlet_check.method: Compare what each outlet asserts. The product is the disagreement map, not a verdict.
show: Where outlets agree (claimed by N of M)
Where outlets disagree (outlet A says X, outlet B says Y)
What is still single-source (only one outlet reports this)
What no outlet has sourced to a primary record
outlet_check.rule: No verdict without a primary record. Disagreement is the product, not a weakness.

grok_scope.constraint: Search for independent coverage to reach the N-outlet threshold; each with dated URL
Check if an official primary has been released since the event; if found, upgrade to anchored

subject_page_updates: Coverage-only events may not have a standing subject page until a second occurrence
If a subject page exists, append the new event
